subject: 荆州太晖观 · 朝圣门、阙楼与祖师殿正面（高台金顶）
name: 荆州太晖观
sub: 朝圣门与祖师殿 · 高台金顶
yearNote: 始建年代不详；明洪武二十六年（1393）就藩荆州的湘献王朱柏出资重建，现存朝圣门、阙楼、祖师殿等为此后历代修缮的格局，具体各殿现存构件年代未查到。年表取1393年。
coordinate_source: Wikidata Q16963508（太晖观 Taihui Guan）P625 坐标 30.3622, 112.165158，道观本体近似坐标，非本项目测绘；地图显示点复用新建的 hb_jingzhou。
lede: 荆州城西郊的太晖观，是明初湘献王朱柏在洪武二十六年（1393）出资重建的道观。正面最醒目的是一座高大的红砖台基：三券门的朝圣门嵌在台底，祖师殿坐在台顶，两侧阙楼拱卫，三座黄琉璃瓦歇山顶并排叠起，像一座缩小的宫城。
facts: 太晖观始建年代不详，明洪武二十六年（1393）由就藩荆州的湘献王朱柏重建；现存观桥、山门、阙楼、朝圣门、祖师殿、文昌宫、药王殿、圣母殿等建筑。
朝圣门开三座券门，上覆黄琉璃瓦歇山门楼；门后石阶分两段登上高台，台顶正中为祖师殿，两侧阙楼各辟拱窗，三座黄瓦歇山顶自左至右并列。
1956年以“太晖观”列为湖北省第一批省级文物保护单位；2006年与玄妙观、开元观合为“荆州三观”，列入第六批全国重点文物保护单位。
caption: 荆州太晖观 · 朝圣门与祖师殿
明 · 1393年重建
structure_checkpoints: 底部：高大的红褐色砖砌台基，正面分为左右两座塔楼状体量（阙楼）与中央略凹进的门段；两座阙楼上部各开一扇半圆拱窗，顶覆黄琉璃瓦歇山顶，山花朝前。
中央：朝圣门为三座并列的半圆券门（中间大、两侧小），中券上方横匾（留白），门楼覆黄琉璃瓦歇山顶，檐下有斗栱与青绿彩画；门前平台上的石香炉去除。
顶部：祖师殿在台顶正中，黄琉璃瓦歇山顶，正脊中央宝顶、两端鸱吻，略高于两侧阙楼；三座黄瓦屋顶自左至右为阙楼—祖师殿—阙楼，中间最高。
台前：一道石阶从院中直上，分两段、中有平台，两侧石栏板与望柱；院中铜香炉亭、焚香炉、两侧白山墙的配殿与树木均不画。
material_observations: 台基与阙楼墙面为红褐色（砖砌抹灰，局部露青砖）；屋面黄色琉璃瓦，脊饰灰色；门楼檐下斗栱青绿，额枋暗红；石阶与栏板灰白色；院地水泥灰色。
author: Zhangzhugang
source_note: 主图为 Zhangzhugang 2014年4月自院中正对朝圣门与祖师殿拍摄（Commons 说明“朝圣门和祖师殿”），高台、三券门、两侧阙楼与祖师殿屋顶完整；无第二张授权照片，裁图 taihui_top 用于核对三座黄瓦屋顶的层次。线稿去除香炉亭、树木与两侧配殿。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Use confident fine contours and a few finer internal structural lines. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. The white canvas will be removed later by a script; draw only the ink strokes and keep all other regions uniformly white.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.

SUBJECT: the central platform group of Taihui Guan Taoist temple in Jingzhou, seen straight-on from the courtyard (Image 2). Draw a tall, broad brick platform whose front is divided into two tower-like blocks (one round-arched window high in each) flanking a slightly recessed central section. In the recessed centre at platform level, the Chaosheng Gate: THREE round arches side by side (the middle one larger), a blank plaque over the middle arch, topped by a small glazed-tile hip-and-gable gatehouse roof. On top of the platform, three hip-and-gable glazed roofs in a row: the central Patriarch Hall roof is the highest with a ridge finial and ridge-end ornaments, the two flanking tower roofs are lower and show their gable ends to the front. A broad stone stair with balustrades climbs from the courtyard straight up to the gate in two flights with a landing. Omit the incense burners, the pavilion in the courtyard, the side halls with white gables at the edges, loudspeakers and trees. Keep the whole platform group centred with its full width.
Orientation: landscape 1536×1024.
